browser_profiles_proxy_check.name: browser_profiles_proxy_check
browser_profiles_proxy_check.value: "browser_profiles"."proxy_kind" = 'none' or ("browser_profiles"."proxy_host" is not null and "browser_profiles"."proxy_port" is not null)

mcp_servers_transport_check.name: mcp_servers_transport_check
mcp_servers_transport_check.value: ("mcp_servers"."transport" = 'stdio' and "mcp_servers"."command" is not null) or ("mcp_servers"."transport" = 'http' and "mcp_servers"."url" is not null)

memories_source_check.name: memories_source_check
memories_source_check.value: ("memories"."source_kind" = 'human' and "memories"."source_by_id" is not null) or ("memories"."source_kind" = 'agent' and "memories"."source_task_id" is not null and "memories"."source_evidence" is not null)

tools_source_check.name: tools_source_check
tools_source_check.value: ("tools"."source" <> 'mcp' or "tools"."server_id" is not null) and ("tools"."source" <> 'http' or "tools"."http" is not null)
